recipe.visualDefinition: A dense, repetitive grid of instant film photographs (Polaroid style) featuring white, colored, and metallic borders. The layout is punctuated by casual, marker-style handwriting on the bottom margins of specific photos, creating a narrative mosaic of candid moments.
coreVisualRelationships: Grid-based repetition of square frames with thick bottom margins
Contrast between white borders and occasional colored/metallic frames
Interplay between candid, low-fidelity photography and clean, structured layout
Integration of handwritten text directly onto the photographic medium
coreInvariants: Square image aspect ratio within the frames
Thick bottom margin on every photo frame
Uniform spacing between frames creating a 'tiled' wall effect
Naturalistic, non-studio lighting in the photography

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A decentralized grid where each photo carries equal weight; the eye moves across the tiles rather than focusing on a single point.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The handwritten text in the upper-middle section acts as the primary entry point for the viewer.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Z-pattern scanning across the grid, following the horizontal lines of the photo borders.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The thin gaps between the photo frames and the white/colored margins of the frames themselves.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and shadows within the candid photographs.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted primary colors (red, blue, gold) used for specific frame borders.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value (bright) borders vs. medium-to-low saturation, high-contrast photographic content.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or overly digital colors

letterConstructionRules: Monolinear stroke width consistent with a felt-tip marker
Slightly irregular baseline and character height
Natural kerning based on hand-writing speed

composition.position: Centered on the bottom margin of specific photo frames
composition.scale: Small relative to the grid, large relative to the margin

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-style handwriting to maintain the 'personal journal' aesthetic.
graphicDevices: Hand-drawn sketches (e.g., bear head) in one frame

candidateDirections.reason: Mimics the felt-tip look of the original lettering.
Provides a similar casual, hand-drawn feel if a font is required.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grid of 25-30 square instant film photos with thick bottom margins. The photos should feature candid, low-fi lifestyle scenes (musicians, nature, social gatherings). Use mostly white borders with 3-4 colored or metallic gold borders interspersed randomly.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add all-caps, black marker-style handwritten text centered in the bottom margins of 3-4 specific photos in the top two rows.

verificationChecks: Are the photo borders thick at the bottom?
Is the text rendered in a casual, monolinear marker style?
Do the photos have a film-like grain and contrast?

adjustableVariables: Ratio of colored borders to white borders
Density of handwritten text vs. blank margins
Subject matter of the candid photos
mustRedesign: Any existing logos or brand names on the mugs or clothing
The specific bear sketch to avoid direct copying

mustAchieve: Authentic instant film texture and border physics
Natural-looking handwriting that doesn't feel like a repetitive font

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is perfectly identical in letter shape to confirm a 'hand-drawn' look.
Check that the bottom margins are significantly larger than the top and side margins.
Verify that the grid feels like a physical collage of separate objects.
Confirm the color palette remains grounded in analog tones.
recipe.reuseFormula: Grid of [Subject] instant film photos + [Color] accent frames + [Handwritten Marker] text in margins.
